class.name: ObfuscationScan
class.brief_description: Result of scanning a path, image, stream, or script for marks.
class.description: Holds a decoded seal (if found), per-file mark rows, matched/total counts, a 0–1 score, and a reconstructed copyright string when the lattice hash matches.

members.member: Mark dictionaries with [code skip-lint]path[/code], [code skip-lint]kind[/code], [code skip-lint]matched[/code], and [code skip-lint]bits[/code].
Owner id taken from the seal when present.
Project id taken from the seal when present.
Reconstructed copyright lattice payload, or empty.
Ratio of matched marks to total marks, or 0 when nothing was scanned.
Decoded claim, if a seal was found.
[code]true[/code] when the scanned seal signature verified.
